rule: A *_DEBUT milestone is the first recorded appearance at a level. A decision row says how that appearance counts as development. No row: the first appearance is the developmental arrival. In an ambiguous sequence every level whose interpretation is unresolved is REVIEW_REQUIRED (unknown, never guessed). Heuristic candidates never become rows without review.
